subject.title: fix(reef): discover trusted peers as conversations

question: Should `conversations.list` permanently refresh and persist channel-directory addresses while allowing conversation records to remain session-unbound until first delivery?
rationale: This changes the Gateway protocol, the observable use of plugin directory adapters, and session-registry invariants; tests establish mechanics but cannot decide the intended long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Retain the generic Gateway design, require the two-peer first-contact proof and changelog cleanup, then merge after confirming existing consumers tolerate unbound conversation records.

options.title: Narrow the discovery contract
options.body: Keep the PR paused while redesigning discovery so Reef-specific enumeration does not establish a generic persistent directory-to-conversation contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Retain the generic Gateway design, require the two-peer first-contact proof and changelog cleanup, then merge after confirming existing consumers tolerate unbound conversation records.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related architecture work and recent changes cover the Reef, Gateway conversation, and session-registry boundaries involved in this decision.
